itens.trecho: Um filme verdadeiramente bom, que me parece estar injustamente esquecido e que vale a pena revisitar. Esperei um bom tempo para ver este filme. Quando foi lançado, beneficiou de toda a máquina de propaganda dos grandes estúdios e fez sucesso.

With the new millennium dawning, fisherman "Solomon" (Djimon Hounsou) is eagerly anticipating the day when his young son "Dia" (Kagiso Kuypers) will realise his dream of becoming a doctor. That idyll is sharply destroyed, though, when his Sierra Leone village is beset by rebels who capture him and force him to work in their diamond mines.

Rewatching Blood Diamond reminded me why it’s such a powerful and unforgettable film. It’s not just a movie—it’s an experience that grabs you by the heart and doesn’t let go. Leonardo DiCaprio delivers one of his best performances as Danny Archer.
